report.summary: Narrow-only PLAY08 minimap legibility correction in backstage-scene.js miniMap; desktop branch, projection (s=0.14, x=772, y=18), panel, all static/dynamic geometry, colors, cues and core/UI untouched. Narrow marker/label metrics now derive from the true CSS scale cssW/1100: 你/回店 = ceil(11/cssScale) internal px, M 全图 = ceil(10/cssScale); arrow r = ceil(6/(1.04*cssScale)) so its facing-east bbox short axis (1.04r) is >=6 CSS px; diamond r = arrow+2 so all four cardinal corners protrude past the overlapping arrow at every facing (old candidate had marker 8 < arrow 9). 你 label placement is narrow-only: above the silhouette with 4px clearance, flips below near the top edge, and its horizontal center is clamped to the panel so full glyph extents stay inside x760..1090/y12..310; markers are never moved from true projected world positions. 回店 keeps its relative placement (ex+marker+3, ey+labelSize/2+1); M anchor unchanged. Added 3 regressions in test-night-map-scene.js (original 12 assertions/tests preserved verbatim, recorder harness unchanged): effective-CSS font sizes and marker short axes from recorded geometry at 320/350/368/390 with documented CJK text metric (1em CJK/0.85em M/0.3em space, 0.8em ascent/0.2em descent), overlap/extent separation, diamond-protrudes-over-arrow across 4 cardinal facings x 4 widths, and B.solid-verified technical edge fixtures for label clamping. Genuine RED confirmed against unmodified candidate: tests 13 failed at '你 >=11 CSS px at 320, got 3.78' (parent finding 4.35 at 368 reproduced) and 14 failed 'diamond corners must protrude ... facing (1,0) width 320' (marker8<arrow9), original 1-12 stayed green; after the fix all 15 pass. Final commands: night-map 15/15 pass, district-core 18/18 pass, both node --check clean. Natural GUI screenshots remain parent work; no gameplay/geometry changes made.
